policy: Only reviewed Bengali-script pronunciation is published; no automatic transliteration is generated. User-approved conventions: preserve the Arabic ayah, use readable Bengali phonetic spelling, and end each line with Bengali danda (।). Bengali transliteration is a reading aid, not tajwid instruction.

coverage.basis: Previously reviewed coverage recorded in version 1.
User confirmed 2:2 and supplied/corrected 2:3 in the prior Work conversation.

verified.note: Only these nine ayahs are counted as reviewed. No other draft line is treated as checked by inference.

draft_candidates.status: Text fields exist for every ayah; the remaining 6227 are unreviewed candidates, not verified pronunciation.

source: Arabic ayah text in the repository; verified coverage is based only on recorded review and explicit user confirmation. Bangladesh government pronunciation source remains linked for uncovered verses.
